title: PAR-134/7Q LIGHT CMC RGB retention
scope: Reproduce loss of the RGB payload from the bounded DRW_Light CMC parser
Retain a decoded C2 RGB value in the typed LIGHT model
Write retained RGB through the existing C2 CMC encoder
Keep the unverified class-specific LIGHT DXF color mapping unchanged

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: R2004+ CMC contains a reserved BS, method-packed BL, and RC optional-name flags; method C2 carries the low 24-bit RGB payload.

autodeskApi.finding: AcDbLight exposes setLightColor(const AcCmColor&), supporting the use of CMC for the LIGHT color property.

localSource.finding: DRW_Light::parseDwg called the bounded CMC helper with null RGB output and DRW_Light::encodeDwg always selected the index-only overload. The parser now retains optional RGB in m_colorRgb; the writer emits C2 when this value is present and validates its range and normalized scalar before body emission.
localSource.compatibility: m_colorRgb is appended after existing public LIGHT fields to preserve offsets of prior members. DRW_Light size changes and downstream binary consumers must rebuild; no virtual method or callback contract changed.

dxfContract.finding: The published LIGHT DXF table does not list a class-specific color group.
dxfContract.decision: Do not infer group 63/421 behavior from other entity classes; leave the DXF writer unchanged pending an authoritative contract or producer witness.

generatedControls.finding: Generated LIGHT frames cover C0 ByLayer, C1 ByBlock, C3 ACI, and C2 RGB. An independent body cursor checks each encoded CMC method/scalar/RGB and the next field; the production parser checks typed color retention and the following hard-pointer sentinel. An out-of-range caller RGB is refused before body bytes are emitted.
generatedControls.limit: Controls are locally generated and are not producer-authored samples. They do not establish the LIGHT DXF color-group mapping or optional CMC name/book roundtrip.

productionSummary: Capture the bounded LIGHT CMC RGB value only when the decoder reports a truecolor payload.
Append m_colorRgb to DRW_Light and reset it to the absent sentinel on parse reset/failure.
Encode retained RGB using the existing validated C2 CMC writer; refuse invalid RGB/scalar combinations before output.
generatedTestSummary: Add generated AC1024 LIGHT frames and an independent CMC wire walk for C0-C3.
Assert parser model retention, subsequent LIGHT field, handle-stream alignment, and malformed RGB refusal.

commands.command: git diff --check -- CMakeLists.txt src/drw_entities.cpp src/drw_entities.h tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md

assessment.confirmedLocalResult: Generated AC1024 LIGHT CMC C2 RGB is retained by the typed parser and emitted by the DWG writer without shifting later fields or handles; C0/C1/C3 paths remain valid in the generated controls.
unresolved: The class-specific LIGHT DXF color-group contract remains unverified; the current DXF writer was intentionally not changed.
Optional CMC color/book names are still not represented by DRW_Light.
The broader scalar-only CMC consumer audit, HATCH C5 producer behavior, and C4/C6-C8 third-party semantics remain open.
Associative-action value grammar and independent/native semantic qualification remain separate open gates.
assessment.nextAction: Continue the class-by-class CMC consumer audit. Resolve LIGHT DXF color mapping only from an authoritative class contract or producer witness; otherwise retain the current visible gate and move to the next evidenced local color-loss item.
